PAT Development Charter
Every module must execute successfully.
Every module must have a test.
No live trading during development
Minimum 300 paper trades before enabling live orders.
Every recommendation must explain "Why?"
Capital protection is more important than trade frequency.
The system must be understandable by a non-expert trader.
